name: Summarize a web page
description: Reads any public web page and returns a short summary with key points.

name: Translate text
description: Translates text into any language, keeping tone and formatting.
input: The text, and the target language (default: Hindi)

name: Generate an image
description: Creates an original 1024x1024 image from a text prompt.

name: Analyze sentiment
description: Scores the sentiment and tone of a text, with the phrases that drive it.
input: The text to analyze, e.g. a review or tweet
